title: Open Streamer
description: Open Streamer dashboard. Requires only Prometheus scraping /metrics.

panels.title: Drops (5m)
panels.description: Any value above zero means a consumer fell behind and packets were dropped.

panels.title: Ingest writes/s
panels.description: Buffer writes: one per access unit on AV sources, one per TS chunk on raw-TS sources.

panels.title: Buffer capacity used
panels.description: Fullest subscriber per buffer. $raw$ is the ingest buffer, $r$…$track_N a rendition. Sustained values above 70% come before drops.

panels.title: Encoded frames/s
panels.description: Frames delivered by the transcoder, per rendition. Audio shared by all renditions has profile=all.

panels.title: Transcoder CPU (cores)
panels.description: CPU of the per-stream subprocess, excluding GPU work. Linux only.

panels.title: Transcoder memory
panels.description: Resident memory of the per-stream subprocess, including libav. Linux only.

panels.title: Push state (worst destination)
panels.description: Grouped per stream on purpose: the dest_url label can contain a stream key.

panels.title: Push bitrate
panels.description: Grouped per stream on purpose: the dest_url label can contain a stream key.

panels.title: Push reconnects
panels.description: Grouped per stream on purpose: the dest_url label can contain a stream key.

panels.title: Seconds since last reconcile
panels.description: The reconciler runs every 10s. Above 60s it is stuck.

panels.title: CPU (cores)
panels.description: Server process only. Transcoder subprocesses are separate and not included.
